scope: Authoring specification only, excluded from runtime manifest and Library content. No media generated for these proposed new entries. Not ready for import.
releaseGates: Actual listening review for every new base, transformed and sentence audio clip.
Visual review of every generated picture against its exact target sense.
Author complete transformation graphs with four-language definition transforms and verify every reachable form.
Resolve complete record graphs, including atomic spelling/readings and English selected-form wrappers.
Compose sentence PCM from exact selected constituent clips; retain independent sentence recordings/provenance separately.
Run module and host import/lifecycle/regression checks after complete implementation.

audio.policy: Use real written language input. Japanese input must contain kana/kanji, never romaji-only. Existing voice inventory is provenance, not spending authorization.

orthographyPolicy: Kana-primary new Japanese vocabulary remains kana-primary until complete Kanji/hidden-reading paths are intentionally authored and reviewed. Existing Kanji words in sentences keep their visible lexical references.

duplicateCheck.scope: All current packaged seed records, including hidden records. External dictionary inventories are not seed duplicates.

readingReviewNotes: きっぷ: preserve small っ before ぷ; do not use full-size つ.
くうこう: preserve both long-vowel sequences くう and こう.
ホーム: ほーむ; パスポート: ぱすぽーと; スーツケース: すーつけーす. Retain the prolonged sound marks.
じてんしゃ: small ゃ after し; not じてんしや.
しゅっぱつする: small ゅ and small っ, followed by ぱ; compound suru inflection requires its own complete transform set.
かう: negative かわない, past かった, te-form かって; not かあない or かいた.
まつ: polite まちます, past まった, te-form まって.
つく (arrive): past ついた, te-form ついて; not the 行く exception.
Stored sentence readings retain written particle は/を; actual listening must verify /wa/ and /o/ in context.
